summary: Write a daily native notice summarizing asks resolved by their deadline

replay.detail: The bound notice-owner daemon derives one immutable digest source and snapshot per person and local date from replicated deadline answers. Authenticated historical source identities fence retries and handovers. Replicated covered-through instants preserve coverage across timezone/time reloads; bounded catch-up emits missed nonempty dates, and previously unreported late replicas appear at the next unissued boundary. Already overridden asks are excluded when the digest is created.

schema.detail: No native claim kinds or claims corpus changes. Rebuildable local_ask_digest_pending/emitted/sources/draft tables incrementally index relevant claim arrivals, authenticated history and bounded payload pages. Digest rows use the existing notice source object or native document references. Reviewed registration pins remain unchanged and survive owner handovers; reserved digest identities carry immutable historical notice-owner authority.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or claims corpus changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional typed notice source digest rows include required resolution claim IDs, the applied answer and an exact work.override episode fence while its seven-day window remains open. Small days inline at most 128 rows; large days use one immutable native digest_document root and decimal-string digest_count, with bounded reverse-linked JSONL fragment documents preserving all rows and long titles losslessly. Optional covered_through and owner_claim metadata record coverage and emission authority. Absent optional fields are omitted. Older clients do not display the new metadata. Existing producer notices retain their agent/person authority.

downtime.detail: Daily scheduling uses reconciler deadline wakes, not polling. Consecutive local calendar boundaries account for daylight-saving changes.

manual.detail: asks.digest_at defaults to 09:00; asks.digest_timezone supplies the fleet timezone and defaults to UTC because person availability currently has no timezone setting. A current notice-owner binding is required. Empty days create no notice. Client digest surfaces are separate from notice generation.

recovery.detail: No owner binding or a non-owner daemon writes nothing. Historical authenticated digest sources remain valid for duplicate prevention after handover; unauthorized imported sources cannot fence an emission. A local cache rebuild recovers coverage and reported resolution IDs from replicated source/document history.
